question: Which dancer won the Padma Shri in the arts category for the ancient dance form, Sathir?
solution:
The correct answer is __**R Muthukannamal.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **R Muthukannamal** won the **Padma Shri** in the arts category for the ancient **dance form, Sathir.**
 
• Sathir is a traditional folk dance form of **Tamil Nadu**, which is performed during the festival of **Pongal.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kaushalya Reddy** is a renowned **Kuchipudi dancer,** who has also received the **Padma Shri** for her contribution to the **field of dance.**
 
• **Manjamma Jogati** is a **Dalit folk artist **from **Karnataka, **who has been recognized for her work in the field of **folk theatre.**
 
• **Tripti Tiwari** is a **Kathak dancer**, who has been awarded the **Sangeet Natak Akademi** Award for her contribution to the **field of dance.**
